Command: Do no servile work on the Day of Trumpets
Summary: On the Day of Trumpets, no servile work may be done; the day is a holy convocation.
Commandment: On the Day of Trumpets, do no servile work.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The work ban set the trumpet memorial apart from ordinary labor. Debated: some see the commanded observance fulfilled as shadow (Colossians 2:16-17); others keep feasts voluntarily as memorial, not as binding command. The site does not settle whether observance continues.
Purpose: To rehearse God's saving acts at appointed seasons (Leviticus 23); Paul calls Christ our Passover (1 Corinthians 5:7).
